flavour: Channelling the violence of their peers, the Shaman projects it against their enemies in a brain-bursting wave.
effect: A single enemy model the caster is engaged in combat with suffers a single Strength 6 hit with the Multiple Wounds (D3) special rule and with no armour or Regeneration saves permitted (Ward saves can be attempted as normal).

flavour: Gork gives the Shaman the ability to project beams of coruscating energy from their eyes, burning massive holes through everything they look at.
effect: Draw a straight line, 5D6” in length, from the caster’s base edge. Any model (friend or foe) whose base falls under this line suffers a Strength 5 hit, with an AP of -3.
